title: The reference Power Risk budget is 200000, ten times the actual sum of the Power Risk source sheet (20000), so a correct agent would be marked wrong.
evidence: gt Master!M44=200000 (hardcoded). 'Power Risk East and West' E7=10000 and E13=10000; the reference itself computes E16=SUM(E3:E13)=20000.
confirmation: gt Master!M44 (Power Risk) is a hardcoded 200000. The 'Power Risk East and West' sheet has only E7=10000 and E13=10000, and the reference's own E16=SUM(E3:E13) gives 20000.

title: The reference grand total includes the inflated Power Risk value and is overstated by 180000.
evidence: gt Master!M69=SUM(M3:M68)=13261750; with M44=20000 the correct total is 13081750.
confirmation: gt Master!M69=SUM(M3:M68) caches 13261750, which includes the inflated 200000. With 20000 the total is 13081750, so a correct total mismatches the key by 180000.
